findings.title: C concrete lease handoff and one official entry remain absent from exact scope
findings.impact: Naive outer lease collides with inner acquisition; releasing it permits a journal race. Central qualification check leaves replacement history unchecked in release_host.

Or release_host acquires central qualification-only lease and reaches store.Open while replacement history is pending.
findings.recommendation: Freeze C-minimal-addendum.json exact paths, opaque borrowed lease adapter and all-entry tests before Source card. Hold one native lease continuously across combined gate and full source workflow.
